metadata.description: Registers a self-hosted integration runtime (SHIR) on an existing Data Factory. This is a required prerequisite for the IRIS ODBC linked service: IRIS/Cache has no Azure-IR path (no public network endpoint an Azure-managed IR can reach without a driver install), so every IRIS<->ADF pipeline needs a SHIR running on a host where the InterSystems ODBC driver is installed. See ../README.md 'Self-hosted IR is mandatory' and ../PUBLISHING.md for why. This template only *registers* the SHIR resource in ADF; it does NOT install the SHIR agent or the ODBC driver -- that is a manual step on the host (see README 'Setting up the self-hosted IR host').
Name of the existing Data Factory to attach this integration runtime to.
Name for the self-hosted IR resource.

description.defaultValue: Self-hosted IR with the InterSystems ODBC driver installed. Register the actual agent by running the key from 'az datafactory integration-runtime list-auth-key' on the host, then install the InterSystems ODBC driver on that same host.
